title: land's doc-row merge leaves the rebase in progress on a non-UTF-8 kb/_self doc and splits a row at U+2028
goal: SP-aoiqmnc6 review G4 (ST-mpwzinrm): rebase_merging_doc_rows reads the conflicted kb/_self doc with read_text(encoding='utf-8') and splits it with str.splitlines, so a doc that is not UTF-8 raises UnicodeDecodeError with the rebase left in progress (UU file, .git/rebase-merge present), and a row holding U+2028, U+0085 or a form feed is written back broken into two lines; a CRLF doc is rewritten LF and a missing final newline is added. A doc the merge cannot read whole is refused with the rebase aborted, and a merged doc keeps every byte outside the merged words.

run:
import sys,os,subprocess,tempfile,io,contextlib
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_land as L
def run(base,main,work):
    t=tempfile.mkdtemp();g=lambda *a:subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=t,capture_output=True)
    g('init','-q','-b','main');g('config','user.email','a@b.c');g('config','user.name','n')
    p=os.path.join(t,'kb/_self/x.md');os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p))
    open(p,'wb').write(base);g('add','-A');g('commit','-qm','b')
    g('checkout','-qb','work');open(p,'wb').write(work);g('commit','-qam','w')
    g('checkout','-q','main');open(p,'wb').write(main);g('commit','-qam','m')
    try:
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):L.rebase_merging_doc_rows(t,'main','work')
    except Exception as e:print('raised',type(e).__name__)
    return os.path.isdir(os.path.join(t,'.git/rebase-merge')),open(p,'rb').read()
latin=run(b'caf\xe9\n| a | p q r z |\n',b'caf\xe9\n| a | k p q r z |\n',b'caf\xe9\n| a | p q r z w |\n')
ls=run('| a | p q r z |\n'.encode(),'| a | k p q r z |\n'.encode(),'| a | p q r z w |\n'.encode())
print('non-utf8 rebase left in progress:',latin[0],'| U+2028 row kept:',b'\xe2\x80\xa8' in ls[1])
sys.exit(0 if not latin[0] and not ls[0] and b'\xe2\x80\xa8' in ls[1] else 1)
